name: An XLSX separates an immediate experiment from future automation
business_context: The workbook contains one sheet for a short preview experiment and another sheet for unapproved future automation.
judge_context: The Agent should inspect both sheets and avoid silently merging the immediate experiment with automation that has not been agreed.

trigger.text: 请根据以上讨论在 Model Delivery 项目把当前确定的工作创建成任务。

messages.text: 我把预发布实验和以后可能做的自动化分别放在两个 Sheet 里。当前先验证预发布。
